title: Long exact Ext cohomology sequence for abelian sheaves
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J, HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat and HasExt (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat), at compatible universes. For every short complex S of abelian sheaves with hS : S.ShortExact and every n : ℕ, define δSucc hS n by postcomposition with hS.extClass. Then H.map S.f 0 is injective, and Function.Exact holds for each of the pairs (H.map S.f n, H.map S.g n), (H.map S.g n, δSucc hS n), and (δSucc hS n, H.map S.f (n + 1)). Here H is Ext from the sheafification of the constant abelian presheaf ℤ, with the library universe lifts.

source.place: Connecting section, Sheaf.H.δSucc and its two exactness lemmas; HOneCokernel section, Sheaf.H.exact_map_map; Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/Ext/ExactSequences.lean, Ext.postcomp_mk₀_injective_of_mono.

proof.text: Define δSucc as hS.extClass.postcomp of the constant integer sheaf. Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₂ gives exactness at H(S.X₂). Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃′ and Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁′ give exactness at H(S.X₃) and H(S.X₁,n+1); ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact translates them to Function.Exact. These are the existing Sheaf.H exactness lemmas in the cited source module. Finally hS.mono_f makes S.f a monomorphism, so postcomposition in Ext degree zero is injective by Ext.postcomp_mk₀_injective_of_mono (equivalently cancellation in Hom via Ext.addEquiv₀). This works also for n=0 and zero sheaves and imposes no terminal-object hypothesis.
